agents.scope: Local models, reasoning and agent frameworks
Complete reusable open-source projects including abandoned projects
Free compute, storage and development tools
License, provenance, dependency and security review

rules: Independent discovery; deduplicate by source and revision
No paid resources or unauthorized access
Do not execute downloaded code outside isolated tests
No automatic deployment or access to credentials
Search existing candidates and reusable implementations before writing new components; prefer complete tested projects, including abandoned projects only when safe and maintainable.
Record a specific blocker, integration effort, and verification evidence before adoption.
Keep navigation redesign and speaker recognition deferred.
status: Policy only; autonomous research runners not implemented
discoveryPriority: Current build blockers and reproducible Android packaging
Persistent memory and optional authorized cloud synchronization
selectionOrder: Demonstrated fit to a current blocker
Zero incremental cost and minimal user setup
